description: Centralized critical-or-worse syslog only. Lower-severity data is intentionally absent because it is filtered at the device, not because the dashboard hides it. Legacy/compatibility dashboard: superseded for new (Django) consumers by the syslog panels on NMAS Resources (nmas-resources) and NMAS Link Events (nmas-link-events), retained unchanged for existing links.

panels.description: The deployed policy forwards emergency, alert, and critical only; current stored data is critical severity.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device, platform: if exists r.platform then r.platform else "unknown"}))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.severity =~ /^${severity:regex}$/)
          |> group()
          |> count()

panels.description: Search/filter the table by device, source, severity, facility, or message. Historical mgmt-swt records are normalized to the canonical mgmt_swt device name.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device, platform: if exists r.platform then r.platform else "unknown"}))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.severity =~ /^${severity:regex}$/)
          |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "platform", "source_ip", "severity", "facility", "_value"])
          |> rename(columns: {_value: "message"})
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
          |> limit(n: 500)

panels.title: Recent critical events

list.definition:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
      |> range(start: -30d)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device}))
      |> keep(columns: ["device"])
      |> group()
      |> distinct(column: "device")
      |> sort(columns: ["device"])
